statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-105437 is tracked in GitLab work item https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/814 . When merging, Git computed the size of the merge result buffer in xdiff/xmerge.c with int arithmetic that can overflow for very large merges, for example many conflicts combined with a large conflict-marker-size, so the buffer could be too small and Git wrote outside it, corrupting the heap. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is in commits https://github.com/git/git/commit/288266c11d91a01239e8e17f4bd90f1276e30030 , which switches those size computations to size_t, and https://github.com/git/git/commit/b1313872cefef5704a0acff14b7c0869a9d5dc7c , which makes them fail on overflow, using the st_add5() helper added in https://github.com/git/git/commit/0dc3b5c0224b985e48be513330f8d79e87db9a12 . The 2.52.1-r0 build is Alpine's security upgrade to Git 2.52.1, which contains the fix: https://git.alpinelinux.org/aports/commit/?id=2f20de3527863b1b84f620fefe687921498e7240 . We checked /usr/bin/git, the program in the git package that contains this code, in both published builds, 2.52.0-r0 and 2.52.1-r0, on x86_64 and aarch64: 2.52.1-r0 contains the new error message "index entry path is too long (" from the same security release, and 2.52.0-r0 does not. Earlier builds of this owner predate the fix.

CVE-2026-105437 is tracked in GitLab work item https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/git/-/work_items/814 . When merging, Git computed the size of the merge result buffer in xdiff/xmerge.c with int arithmetic that can overflow for very large merges, for example many conflicts combined with a large conflict-marker-size, so the buffer could be too small and Git wrote outside it, corrupting the heap. Upstream fixed it in Git 2.50.2, 2.51.3, 2.52.1, 2.53.1, 2.54.1, 2.55.1 and 2.56.1, as the Git 2.50.2 release notes describe: https://github.com/git/git/blob/v2.50.2/Documentation/RelNotes/2.50.2.adoc . The fix is in commits https://github.com/git/git/commit/288266c11d91a01239e8e17f4bd90f1276e30030 , which switches those size computations to size_t, and https://github.com/git/git/commit/b1313872cefef5704a0acff14b7c0869a9d5dc7c , which makes them fail on overflow, using the st_add5() helper added in https://github.com/git/git/commit/0dc3b5c0224b985e48be513330f8d79e87db9a12 . Debian's git 1:2.47.3-0+deb13u1 does not include it, and the Debian tracker lists trixie as vulnerable: https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-105437 . DHI backports the three commits unmodified. The fixed version is the first build that carries the backport, and its shipped changelog lists it. We compared the git package of the two builds in the DHI Debian repository, on amd64 and arm64, using the symbol tables in git-dbgsym: in /usr/bin/git, xdl_fill_merge_buffer() grows from 1690 to 1972 bytes on amd64 and from 1420 to 1652 bytes on arm64, and xdl_recs_copy_0() from 267 to 338 and from 280 to 396 bytes, between the build before the fix and the fixed build. Earlier builds of 2.47.3-0+deb13u1 also predate the backport.
